blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Language priors in MLLMs can override visual evidence, impairing visual perception. Existing benchmarks assume shared priors across models and rely solely on accuracy. However, cross-model prior agreement falls below 80%, and over 15% of items can be answered correctly without any image, causing accuracy to overestimate prior resistance. To address these limitations, we introduce ViSiP-Bench, a benchmark grounded in rare-but-real scenarios across six prior categories, with a model-aware dynamic prior induction protocol and three metrics that more precisely and continuously measure prior resistance than accuracy alone. Evaluating 24 models reveals that prior adherence is pervasive, does not improve with scale, and larger models tend to either strongly override their priors or firmly adhere to them. We therefore propose MAPS, which identifies each model's strongest priors and fine-tunes on factually grounded knowledge to soften excessive prior reliance without disrupting general capabilities.
blocks.zh: MLLMs中的语言前身可以覆盖视觉证据,损害视觉感知. 现有基准假定各模型共享前科,并完全依赖准确性。 然而,跨模型的先行协议低于80%,超过15%的项目可以在没有任何图像的情况下正确回答,导致准确性高估了先行阻力. 为了克服这些局限性,我们采用了ViSiP-Bench,这是以稀有但真实的情景为基础的基准,涵盖前6个类别,它有一个具有模型意识的动态前导协议和三个衡量标准,比仅精确性更精确和持续地衡量以前的阻力。 对24个模型的评价表明,以往的遵守情况很普遍,没有随着规模的扩大而改善,较大的模型往往会强烈地超越其前科或坚决遵守。 因此,我们提出MAPS,它确定每个模型最强的前科,并对基于事实的知识进行微调,以缓和先前过度依赖,而不会破坏一般能力。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Language priors are an inherent byproduct of MLLM pretraining, encoding world knowledge that underpins model reasoning ( Han et al., 2026 ) . Yet when conflicting with visual evidence, language priors can override perceptual processing, causing models to report what they believe rather than what they observe. As illustrated in Figure 1 , when explicitly prompted to report the answer written by the boy in the image, most mainstream MLLMs default to their arithmetic prior and respond with 114, despite the image clearly showing 110. Language priors pose a direct threat to safety-critical applications such as medical imaging and industrial defect inspection, where accurate visual perception is extremely essential.
blocks.zh: 语言前身是MLLM预训的固有副产品,编码了支撑模型推理的世界知识(Han等,2026. 然而,当与视觉证据相冲突时,语言前科可以凌驾于知觉处理之上,导致模型报告他们所相信的而不是所观察到的. 如图1所示,当明确要求报告男孩在图像中写下的答案时,大多数主流的MLLMs默认先于算术并用114来回复,尽管图像明显显示110. 语言前科对医疗成像和工业缺陷检查等安全关键应用构成直接威胁,准确的视觉感知是极其重要的.

blocks.en: Existing benchmarking works ( Guan et al., 2024 ; Lee et al., 2025 ; Luo et al., 2024 ) typically assume that all models share the same commonsense priors, and accordingly construct anomalous datasets where visual signals conflict with those priors, reporting accuracy as the sole metric to quantify prior resistance. We challenge this paradigm on two fronts. First, our cross-model analysis reveals that prior agreement falls below 80%, directly undermining the shared-prior assumption. Second, as shown in Figure 2 , over 15% of items across existing benchmarks can be answered correctly without any image, arising from three sources: (1) Chance Success : insufficient model capability leads to random correct responses; (2) Low-quality Framing : questions that interfere with the model’s prior selection; (3) Anomalous Prior : models inherently treat the anomalous answer as prior.
blocks.zh: 现有基准工作(Guan等人, 2024; Lee等,2025;Luo等,2024) 通常假设所有模型都具有相同的常识前缀,因此在视觉信号与前缀相冲突的地方构建异常数据集,报告准确性是量化前缀阻抗的唯一度量. 我们从两个方面挑战这一模式。 第一,我们的跨模型分析显示,先前的协议低于80%,直接破坏了共享优先假设。 第二,如图2所示,现有基准中超过15%的项目可以正确回答,而没有任何图像,来源有三: (1) 成功的可能性:模型能力不足导致随机作出正确的反应; (2)低质量的Framing:干扰模型之前选择的问题; (3)异常的Prior:模型内在地将异常的答案视为前作.

blocks.en: Therefore, we introduce ViSiP-Bench, a redesigned benchmark for evaluating language prior dependency. Inspired by Ilievski et al. (2021) , we categorize language priors into six domains tailored for MLLMs (Figure 3 ). The dataset is grounded in real-world rare scenes retrieved from the web, supplemented by generative models including GPT-Image-2 ( OpenAI, 2026b ) and Nano Banana 2 ( Google, 2026 ) to synthesize images across diverse visual styles, thereby avoiding biases introduced by image source or visual style. To eliminate Low-quality Framing , every sample undergoes double-blind human review to ensure annotation quality. To mitigate the confounding effects of Chance Success and Anomalous Prior , ViSiP-Bench adopts a dynamic prior induction protocol: each model is first queried without any image to elicit its Blank-condition answer. Building on this, PAR (Prior Adherence Rate) measures the frequency of a model adhering to its Blank-condition answer when the image is added. To further render both PAR and Accuracy more precise, items already answered correctly under the Blank condition are filtered out. Moreover, VIG (Visual Information Gain) quantifies the confidence shift induced by adding the image, providing a continuous and fine-grained measure of prior resistance.
blocks.zh: 因此,我们引入了ViSiP-Bench,这是一个重新设计的用于评价语言前依赖性的基准. 在Ilievski等人(2021年)的启发下,我们将语言前缀分类为6个针对MLLMs(图3. 该数据集以从网络上取回的现实世界稀有场景为基础,由GPT-Image-2(OpenAI,2026b)和Nano Banana 2(Google,2026)等基因模型作补充,以合成不同视觉风格的图像,从而避免由图像源或视觉风格引入的偏见. 为了消除低质量的Framing,每个样本都经过双盲人审查,以确保注释质量. 为了减轻“成功机会”和“异常因素”的困惑效应,ViSiP-Bench采用了动态的先入为主的协议:首先在没有任何图像的情况下询问每个模型,以得出其空白条件的答案。 在此基础上,PAR(先入为主的遵守率)测量一个模型在图像被添加时遵循其空白条件答案的频率. 为了进一步使PAR和准确性更加精确,在空白条件下已正确回答的项目将被过滤出。 此外,VIG(视觉信息增益)对通过增加图像而引发的信心转变进行了量化,提供了连续和精细的先前阻力度量.

blocks.en: Evaluation on ViSiP-Bench reveals that prior adherence is pervasive across mainstream MLLMs and does not improve with scale; on several categories, larger models adhere to their priors even more strongly than smaller counterparts. Among inference-time interventions, prompt-level strategies yield only marginal gains, and chain-of-thought reasoning consistently amplifies prior adherence. These findings indicate that inference-time strategies alone are insufficient to address language prior dependency.
blocks.zh: 对ViSiP-Bench的评价表明,以往的遵守情况在主流的MLLMs中普遍存在,没有随着规模的提高而得到改进;在若干类别中,较大的模型坚持其前科的程度甚至比较小的对应模型更为强烈。 在推断时间干预中,迅速的战略只产生微不足道的收益,思维链推理不断扩大先前的遵守。 这些调查结果表明,仅靠推断时间战略不足以解决语言依赖问题。

blocks.en: We therefore propose MAPS (Model-Aware Prior Softening), a training-based method that softens excessive prior reliance by enriching each model with targeted factually grounded knowledge of rare-but-real scenarios, without suppressing priors indiscriminately or degrading existing capabilities. MAPS substantially improves VIG and reduces PAR on ViSiP-Bench, while preserving performance on reasoning and general vision benchmarks, demonstrating that enhanced visual reliance can be achieved without compromising general capabilities.
blocks.zh: 因此,我们提议采用基于培训的方法,即通过以对稀有但真实的情景有针对性的事实依据的知识来丰富每个模式,从而减轻对先前的过度依赖,同时又不滥杀或贬低现有能力。 MAPS大幅度地改进了VIG并减少了ViSiP-Bench上的PAR,同时保持了推理和一般视觉基准上的性能,表明可以在不损害一般能力的情况下实现增强视觉依赖.

blocks.en: 2 Related Works
blocks.zh: 2 相关工程

blocks.en: 2.1 Language Priors in MLLMs
blocks.zh: 2.1 MLLMs语言前传

blocks.en: Recent analyses reveal that language priors in MLLMs strike a delicate balance between visual perception and reasoning. Han et al. (2026) show that while priors benefit high-level reasoning, they frequently mislead models in perception-critical tasks. Mechanistic studies further localize this tension: visual evidence only begins to influence hidden states at a specific point in the transformer stack ( Long et al., 2026 ) , and extended chain-of-thought reasoning further suppresses visual attention, amplifying hallucination ( Xu et al., 2026b ) .
blocks.zh: 最近的分析显示,MLLMs中的语言前言在视觉感知和推理之间达成了微妙的平衡. Han等人(2026年)表明,虽然前科有利于高层次的推理,但在感知关键任务中经常误导模型. 机械学研究进一步将这种张力本地化:视觉证据只在变压器堆栈的特定点上开始影响被隐藏的状态(Long等,2026年),延伸的思维链推理进一步抑制了视觉注意力,放大了幻觉(Xu等,2026年b).

blocks.en: 2.2 Benchmarking Language Priors
blocks.zh: 2.2 语文前述基准

blocks.en: Several benchmarks have been proposed to quantify language prior dependency. HallusionBench ( Guan et al., 2024 ) pairs Easy/Hard counterparts on counterfactual images; VLind-Bench ( Lee et al., 2025 ) gates LP scoring through a four-stage sequential protocol; Golovanevsky et al. (2025) and VisuLogic ( Xu et al., 2026a ) design stimuli that resist language-mediated shortcuts. Despite their diversity, these works share a common evaluation pattern that assumes shared priors across models and relies solely on accuracy, which, as shown in Figure 2 , underestimates the complexity of prior dependency.
blocks.zh: 已提出若干基准,以量化以往语言依赖。 Hallusion Bench(Guan等,2024年)对等反事实图像上的Easy/Hard对等;VLind-Bench(Lee等,2025年)出闸LP通过四个相继协议打分;Golovanevsky等(2025年)和VisuLogic(Xu等,2026a年)设计刺激来抵制由语言调解的快捷方式. 尽管这些作品具有多样性,但它们都有一个共同的评价模式,假定各模型共享前科,并完全依赖准确性,如图2所示,这低估了以往依赖的复杂性。

blocks.en: 2.3 Mitigating Language Priors
blocks.zh: 2.3 缓解语言前言

blocks.en: Methods that mitigate excessive prior reliance fall into three families. Decoding-time methods adjust output distributions without modifying weights, typically by contrasting logits from perturbed or instruction-only forward passes ( Leng et al., 2024 ; Favero et al., 2024 ) . Attention-level interventions redirect internal computation toward visual tokens by editing attention weights ( Huang et al., 2024 ; Golovanevsky et al., 2025 ; Liu et al., 2024 ; Zhou et al., 2025 ) . Training-based methods modify the model itself through preference optimization, counterfactual training, or visual grounding objectives ( Zhang et al., 2025b ; Zhang et al., 2025a ; Wu et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 减轻过度依赖性的方法分为三个家庭。 解码-时间方法在不修改权重的情况下调整出输出分布,一般通过从扰动或指令性前行通行证中对比出对数(Leng等,2024;Favero等,2024). 注意级干预通过编辑注意分量将内部计算转向视觉符号(黄克文等,2024;高洛瓦内夫斯基等,2025;刘克文等,2024;周克等,2025)。 基于培训的方法通过优化偏好、反事实培训或视觉定位目标来修改模型本身(Zhang等,2025b; 张等,2025a;吴等,2026.

blocks.en: 3 ViSiP-Bench
blocks.zh: 3 ViSiP-奔驰

blocks.en:
Existing benchmarks for language prior dependency share three limitations.
First, they assume shared commonsense priors across models and apply a fixed anomalous answer set, yet cross-model prior agreement falls below 80%, as demonstrated in Figure 4 .
Second, over 15% of items can be answered correctly without any image (Figure 2 ), stemming from three sources: (1) Chance Success : the model lacks a sufficiently strong prior on the question, leading to random correct responses rather than genuine prior-driven selection; (2) Low-quality Framing : poorly designed questions that interfere with the model’s prior selection, either by implicitly hinting at the anomalous answer ( e.g. , “ what is unusual in this image? ”) or by introducing ambiguity ( e.g. , asking “ what color is the watermelon? ” without specifying flesh or rind); (3) Anomalous Prior : the model inherently treats the anomalous answer as its own prior, meaning the question does not actually induce a prior-vision conflict. Identification methodology and typical cases are provided in Appendix A . Together, these factors cause accuracy to overestimate prior resistance.
Third, conflict stimuli typically depict physically impossible counterfactuals rather than rare-but-real scenarios, conflating prior dependency with reasoning about the impossible.
blocks.zh:
以往语文依赖性的现有基准有三个共同的限制。
首先,他们假设各模型之间有共同的常识前科,并采用固定的异常答案集,但如图4所示,跨模型前协议低于80%。
第二,超过15%的项目可以在没有任何图像的情况下得到正确回答(图2),来源有三: (1) 可能的成功:模型在问题之前不够强大,导致随机的正确反应,而不是真正的事先驱动的选择;(2) 低质量的Framing:设计不当的问题干扰了模型先前的选择,要么暗示异常的答案(例如, " 图像中有什么不寻常之处? " ),要么引入歧义(例如,询问 " 西瓜是什么颜色? " ,而未具体说明肉和红; (3)异常事前:模型内在地将异常事后答视为自己的事前答题,指问题实际上不会引发事前想题的冲突. 鉴定方法和典型案例载于附录A。 这些因素加在一起导致准确性高估了先前的抗药性.
第三,冲突刺激通常描绘的是实际上不可能的反事实,而不是罕见但真实的情况,将先前的依赖性与不可能的推理混为一谈。

blocks.en: To address these limitations, we introduce ViSiP-Bench ( Visual Signal vs. Language Prior ). ViSiP-Bench ensures all images depict rare-but-real scenarios rather than physically impossible counterfactuals, applies rigorous quality review to eliminate low-quality framing, and introduces model-aware metrics that filter out items answerable without any image, further mitigating the confounding effects of all three sources. Table 1 presents a detailed comparison between ViSiP-Bench and existing benchmarks.
blocks.zh: 为解决这些局限性,我们引入了ViSiP-Bench(视觉信号与语言前. ViSiP-Bench确保所有图像描绘出稀有但真实的情景,而不是物理上不可能的反事实,采用严格的质量审查来消除低质量的设定,并引入了能过滤出无任何图像可回答项目的模型感知度量衡,进一步减轻了所有三个源的困惑效应. 表1详细比较了ViSiP-Bench和现有基准。

blocks.en: ViSiP-Bench organizes samples into six domains following Ilievski et al. (2021) : Physical Properties , Time & Space , Scientific & Mathematic , Customs & Culture , Psychology Cognition , and Function Cognition . Dataset construction proceeds in four steps.

blocks.en: Step 1: Prior Enumeration. For each domain, we prompt Claude Opus 4.7 ( Anthropic, 2026b ) to enumerate prevalent commonsense priors ( e.g. , “water flows downward” ), yielding 200 priors per domain and 1,200 priors in total.
blocks.zh: 第1步:先点名. 对于每个域,我们促使克洛德·奥普斯·4.7(Anthropic, 2026b)列举出流行的常识前科(例如"水向下流"),每个域产生200个前科,总共1200个前科.

blocks.en: Step 2: Rare-but-Real Generation. For each prior, Claude Opus 4.7 generates three rare-but-real counterpart scenarios that genuinely exist but violate the typical expectation ( e.g. , “water appears to flow upward in a magic performance” ).
blocks.zh: 第2步:稀有但真实的一代. Claude Opus 4.7对每一个前作都产生出三种罕见但真实的对应情景,这些情景确实存在,但违反了典型的期望(例如,“在魔术表演中,水似乎向上流动”)。

blocks.en: Step 3: Image Collection. For each rare-but-real scenario, real photographs are first retrieved from the web; where sufficient images cannot be found, GPT-Image-2 and Nano Banana 2 synthesize supplementary samples across diverse visual styles, including photorealistic, anime, oil painting, and sci-fi. Examples of each style are provided in Appendix B .
blocks.zh: 第3步:图像收藏. 对于每一种稀有但真实的情景,真实相片首先从网络上取出;在无法找到足够相片的地方,GPT-Image-2和Nano Banana 2合成了不同视觉风格的补充相片,包括相片现实相片,动画相片,油画相片等. 附录B提供了每种样式的实例。

blocks.en: Step 4: Question and Option Design. Annotators identify the anomalous element in each image and design a question with four answer choices, such that the correct answer under the visual condition differs clearly from the expected answer under the text-only condition. Each sample then undergoes a quality review requiring three criteria to be satisfied: (1) the image is visually clear and unambiguously supports a single correct answer; (2) all answer choices are directly relevant to the question, preventing models from selecting the correct answer by elimination; and (3) the question wording contains no hint of anomaly, ensuring that prior activation is not suppressed before the model processes the image. Details on annotator requirements and details are provided in Appendix D .
blocks.zh: 第4步:问题与选择设计. 注释者在每个图像中识别出异常元素,并设计出一个有四个答案选择的问题,这样在视觉条件下的正确答案就明显不同于在文本唯一条件下的预期答案. 然后每个样本进行质量审查,要求满足三个标准:(1)图像是视觉清晰而毫不含糊地支持一个单一的正确答案;(2)所有答案选择都与问题直接相关,防止模型通过去除来选择正确的答案;(3)问题措辞没有暗示异常,确保在模型处理图像之前不会压制前激活. 关于注释员要求的详细情况和细节见附录D。

blocks.en: Through the above pipeline, we construct ViSiP-Bench, a benchmark of 4,500 rare-but-real image-question pairs spanning six prior categories and diverse visual styles, each designed to surface genuine conflicts between visual signals and language priors.
blocks.zh: 通过上述管道,我们建造了ViSiP-Bench,这是4,500个稀有但真实的图像问题对的基准,跨越了之前的6个类别和不同的视觉风格,每个类型都旨在显示视觉信号和语言前身之间的真正冲突.

blocks.en: Finding 2: Larger models exhibit a VIG polarization effect. blocks.en: 4 Model-Aware Prior Softening
blocks.zh: 4 型号软件先软化

blocks.en: 4.1 Motivation
blocks.zh: 4.1 动机

blocks.en: § 3.3 demonstrates that language prior dependency persistently impairs visual perception across mainstream MLLMs and does not diminish with scale. Existing inference-time interventions offer a training-free alternative, but their effect is fundamentally bounded by what decoding-time signals can recover from a fixed network, making it difficult to achieve substantial prior resistance, as empirically confirmed in § 5.2 . Training-based methods offer stronger corrections, but existing approaches directly suppress the probability of prior-driven outputs during training, indiscriminately reducing the model’s confidence in its prior knowledge regardless of whether that knowledge is harmful or benign. This risks disrupting the model’s broader understanding of the real world and degrading general capabilities as a consequence.
blocks.zh: §3.3表明,语言的先天依赖性持续地损害整个主流的MLLMs的视觉感知,并且不会随着规模而减少. 现有的推断时间干预提供了一种无培训的替代方法,但其影响从根本上取决于解码时间信号可从固定网络中恢复到何种程度,因此难以实现实质性的事先阻力,经验在第5.2节中得到了证实。 以培训为基础的方法提供了更强的校正,但现有方法直接抑制了在培训期间产生先前驱动的产出的可能性,不加区别地降低了模型对其先前知识的信心,无论这种知识是有害的还是良性的。 这有可能破坏模型对现实世界的更广泛理解并因此削弱一般能力。

blocks.en: We propose MAPS (Model-Aware Prior Softening), which takes a different stance. Rather than suppressing priors, MAPS softens them by enriching the model’s knowledge with rare-but-real scenarios that the prior rarely accounts for. This leaves the model’s existing knowledge intact while specifically targeting the priors that demonstrably interfere with visual perception.
blocks.zh: 我们提议采用不同的立场。 MAPS不是压制前科,而是用以前很少说明的稀有但真实的情况来丰富模型的知识来软化它们。 这让模型的现有知识完好无损,

blocks.en: 4.2 Method
blocks.zh: 4.2 方法

blocks.en: As illustrated in Figure 6 , MAPS operates in five steps.
blocks.zh: 如图6所示,MAPS分五个步骤运作。

blocks.en: For each prior, Claude Opus 4.7 generates a question with 10 plausible answer options designed to elicit the model’s prior belief.
blocks.zh: Claude Opus 4.7提出一个问题, 提出10个合理的答案,

blocks.en: Table 3: Comparison of inference-time and training-based methods on ViSiP-Bench evaluated on Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct.
blocks.zh: 表3:根据Qune3-VL-8B-指令评价的ViSiP-Bench的推论时间和培训方法比较.

blocks.en: Each target model is queried on all generated questions, and the probability distribution over the 10 options is obtained via softmax over the output logits.
blocks.zh: 每个目标模型都对所有产生的问题进行询问,10个选项的概率分布通过输出日志的软马克思获得.

blocks.en: Questions where any single option receives a probability exceeding α \alpha (a hyperparameter controlling the strength of prior selection) are retained. These correspond to priors the model holds with high confidence, and their associated prior statements are selected.
blocks.zh: 任何单一选项的概率超过α-α(控制先前选择强度的超参数)的问题保留。 这些都与模型所持有的先行性相当,并选择了它们相关的前言。

blocks.en: For each selected prior statement, Claude Opus 4.7 generates 20 rare-but-real single-sentence descriptions that are factually grounded yet contradict the prior. To prevent data contamination, the generated content is kept entirely disjoint from ViSiP-Bench at the prompt level.
blocks.zh: 克劳德·奥普斯·4.7对每一份选定的前述陈述提出了20个罕见但真实的单一判决描述,这些描述有事实依据,但与前述陈述相矛盾。 为防止数据被污染,生成的内容与ViSiP-Bench在即时水平上完全脱节.

blocks.en: The rare-but-real sentences are aggregated into a model-specific corpus for supervised fine-tuning via LoRA, where each sentence serves as a training target to enrich the model’s world knowledge.
blocks.zh: 罕见但真实的句子被汇总成一个通过LORA监督微调的特有模式,其中每一句都作为培训目标来丰富该模式的世界知识.

blocks.zh: 5个实验

blocks.en: 5.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 5.1 实验设置

blocks.en: Implementation Details. All training-based methods are implemented on 4 NVIDIA A100 80GB GPUs. MAPS is applied to Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct via LoRA fine-tuning for 2 epochs, with the prior probing threshold set to α = 0.90 \alpha=0.90 unless specified. To assess whether these improvements generalize beyond a single backbone, we further apply MAPS under an identical configuration to six additional models spanning three architecture families, with full results reported in Appendix C .
blocks.zh: 执行细节。 所有基于培训的方法在4 NVIDIA A100 80GB GPU上实施. MAPS适用于通过LORA微调对2个纪元的Qwen3-VL-8B-指令,前作的测试阈值被设定为α=0.90\alpha=0.90,除非指定. 为了评估这些改进是否超越单一骨干,我们进一步在相同的配置下将MAPS应用于涵盖三个建筑家族的另外六个模型,附录C报告了全部结果。

blocks.en: Baselines. We compare MAPS against representative methods from both inference-time and training-based families.
blocks.zh: 基线。 我们比较MAPS与来自推断时间和培训家庭的代表性方法。

blocks.en: For inference-time methods: VFP (Visual-Focused Prompt) instructs the model to focus on the image before responding; CoT ( Wei et al., 2022 ) prompts step-by-step reasoning; AS (Attention Steering) uniformly amplifies visual token attention weights without modifying logits; VCD ( Leng et al., 2024 ) subtracts logits from a perturbed-image forward pass to suppress prior-driven tokens; PAI ( Liu et al., 2024 ) combines visual attention amplification with text-only logit subtraction as a language prior basal.
blocks.zh: 对于推断时间方法:VFP(Visual-Foculed Point)指示模型在响应前关注图像;COT(Wei等,2022年)提示分步推理;AS(Attention Direction)统一地放大视觉信号的注意分量而无需修改对数;VCD(Leng等,2024年)从扰动图像前传中减去对数以压制前传信号;PAI(Lu等,2024年)将视觉注意分量放大与仅文本的对数递减作为前传语言.

blocks.en: For training-based methods: Post-hoc ( Zhang et al., 2025a ) penalizes prior-driven outputs via empty-image probability estimation; NaPO ( Zhang et al., 2025b ) applies noise-aware preference optimization to suppress the model’s preference for language-prior-driven answers over visually grounded ones.
blocks.zh: 培训方法: 后浩克(Zhang等,2025a)通过空想概率估计来惩罚先前所驱动的输出;NaPO(Zhang等,2025b)运用噪声感偏好优化来压制该模型偏好语言前所驱动的答案而不是视觉受限的答案.

blocks.en: Benchmarks for Generalization. We evaluate generalization on two dimensions. For visual reasoning, we use MMMU-Pro ( Yue et al., 2025 ) , which explicitly filters out text-only solvable questions to assess genuine visual reasoning across multiple disciplines, and VisuLogic ( Xu et al., 2026a ) , which eliminates all textual shortcuts and focuses purely on vision-based logical deduction. For general visual understanding, we use MMStar ( Chen et al., 2024 ) , which covers six core visual capabilities, and RealWorldQA, which tests spatial and physical understanding on authentic real-world photographs.
blocks.zh: 一般化基准。 我们评价两个层面的概括。 对于视觉推理,我们使用MMMU-Pro(Yue等,2025年),它明确过滤出文本上唯一可溶解的问题,以评估跨多门学科的真正视觉推理,而VisuLogic(Xu等,2026a)则删除了所有的文字快捷键,并完全专注于基于视觉的逻辑推理. 为了一般的视觉理解,我们使用涵盖6个核心视觉能力的MMStar(Chen等,2024年)和真实世界QA(RealWorldQA),在真实真实世界相片上测试空间和物理理解.

blocks.en: 5.2 Main Results
blocks.zh: 5.2 主要成果

blocks.en: Table 3 presents the results of all methods on ViSiP-Bench. Inference-time methods yield limited improvements overall, while training-based methods prove more effective but differ substantially in how they achieve gains.
blocks.zh: 表3列出了关于ViSiP-Bench的所有方法的结果。 推论时间方法总体改进有限,而以培训为基础的方法证明更有效,但在如何取得成果方面却大相径庭。

blocks.en: Among inference-time methods, CoT consistently hurts performance, confirming that extended reasoning amplifies prior adherence rather than reducing it. VFP and AS yield only marginal gains, suggesting that neither explicit visual instruction nor attention redistribution is sufficient to shift the model’s confidence toward visual evidence. VCD and PAI achieve the best inference-time results, indicating that directly suppressing prior-driven logits at the decoding stage is a more effective direction, though the overall improvement remains limited.
blocks.zh: 在推论时间方法中,COT一贯会伤害性能,证实扩展推理会放大先前的遵守,而不是减少. VFP 和 AS 只能产生微小的收益, 说明既无明确的视觉指示, 也无再分配注意力, VCD和PAI取得了最好的推断时间结果,表明在解码阶段直接压制先前驱动的日志是一个更有效的方向,尽管总体改进仍然有限.

blocks.en: Among training-based methods, Post-hoc achieves the lowest PAR but at a significant cost: FC increases from 147 to 385, indicating that its probability penalization severely disrupts the model’s prior knowledge and causes prior responses to collapse toward random. NaPO improves over the baseline but with limited gains. MAPS achieves the strongest PAR and VIG improvements while maintaining FC at 154, close to the baseline. This demonstrates that supplementing the model with factually grounded rare-but-real knowledge, rather than suppressing priors directly, is a more effective and less destructive approach to enhancing visual reliance.
blocks.zh: 在基于培训的方法中,后热能达到最低的PAR,但成本很高:FC从147增加到385,表明其惩罚的概率严重地扰乱了模型的先前知识,并导致先前对随机崩溃的反应。 NAPO比基线有所改善,但收益有限。 MAPS实现最强的PAR和VIG改进,同时将FC保持在154,接近基线. 这表明,用基于事实的稀有但实际的知识来补充模型,而不是直接压制前科,是增强视觉依赖的更有效和破坏性较小的办法。

blocks.en: This advantage is not specific to Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct. Extending MAPS to six additional models spanning three architecture families yields consistent reductions in PAR and gains in VIG, with FC remaining close to the base model throughout, as reported in Table 8 of Appendix C .
blocks.zh: 这一优势并非Quen3-VL-8B-指令所特有的. 如附录C表8所报告,将 " 最低生活水平 " 扩展至涵盖三个建筑家庭的另外六个模型,使得PAR和VIG的增益持续减少,而FC在整个过程中仍然接近基准模型。

blocks.en: 5.3 Further Analysis
blocks.zh: 5.3 进一步分析

blocks.en: Generalization Analysis. Table 4 reports results on reasoning and general vision benchmarks. Post-hoc suffers substantial degradation across all four benchmarks, consistent with its destructive effect on prior knowledge observed in Table 3 . NaPO also declines across all tasks, though to a lesser extent, indicating that preference-based optimization incurs a non-trivial cost to general capabilities. MAPS maintains performance close to the baseline across all benchmarks, demonstrating that it leaves the model’s reasoning and general visual capabilities largely intact. Unlike prior suppression methods that sacrifice general capabilities for prior resistance, MAPS acquires more comprehensive world knowledge through rare-but-real supervision, preserving the model’s understanding of the real world.
blocks.zh: 通论分析. 表4报告推理和一般愿景基准的结果。 根据表3所示对先前知识的破坏作用,在四种基准中,大面积退化。 NAPO在所有任务中也有所下降,但程度较小,这表明基于优惠的优化给一般能力带来非部落成本。 MAPS在所有基准中保持接近基线的性能,表明它使模型的推理和一般视觉能力基本完好无损. 与先前的压制方法,即牺牲一般能力来进行抵抗不同,MAPS通过稀有但真实的监督,获得更全面的世界知识,保持模型对现实世界的理解.

blocks.en: This preservation effect likewise generalizes across models and architectures. Extending MAPS to six additional models leaves performance on all four generalization benchmarks within a narrow margin, with the largest absolute change reaching only 0.87 points and no consistent direction of degradation, as reported in Table 9 of Appendix C .
blocks.zh: 这种保存效果同样概括了各种模式和结构。 如附录C表9所报告,将MAPS扩大到另外6个模型,使所有4个通用基准的性能都处于狭小的幅度之内,最大的绝对变化只达到0.87分,没有一致的降解方向。

blocks.en: Ablation on Prior Probing Threshold. To isolate the effect of the threshold α \alpha from training data quantity, we control the total training data to match that of α = 0.90 \alpha=0.90 . For lower thresholds where more priors are selected, we proportionally reduce the number of rare-but-real descriptions per prior; for higher thresholds where fewer priors are selected, we prompt Claude Opus 4.7 to generate additional descriptions per prior to reach the same total. Table 5 reports results across four threshold values. A low threshold such as α = 0.50 \alpha=0.50 selects a large number of priors indiscriminately, including many that the model does not strongly hold, which interferes with targeted prior softening and leads to suboptimal performance on both ViSiP-Bench and generalization benchmarks. A high threshold such as α = 0.95 \alpha=0.95 is overly restrictive, covering too few priors to achieve meaningful improvement in visual perception. α = 0.90 \alpha=0.90 achieves the best balance, maximally improving visual perception while preserving the model’s reasoning and general capabilities.
blocks.zh: 校对:Portnoy 为了将阈值α-α的效应从培训数据数量中分离出来,我们控制培训数据总数,使其与α=0.90-α=0.90相匹配。 对于选择更多前题的更低阈值,我们按比例减少每个前题的稀有但真实的描述数量;对于选择较少前题的更高阈值,我们促使克洛德·奥普斯4.7在达到同样总数之前生成每个前题的额外描述. 表5报告得出了四个阈值。 α = 0.50\alpha = 0.50等低阈值不分青红皂白地挑选出大量前科,包括许多模型没有强烈持有的,这干扰了预定的先软化,导致ViSiP-Bench和通化基准的性能不理想. α = 0.95\alpha = 0.95等高阈值限制过强,覆盖了太多的前科,无法实现视觉感知的有意义的改善. α = 0.90\alpha = 0.90 实现最佳平衡,在保持模型推理和一般能力的同时,最大限度地改善视觉感知.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: We present ViSiP-Bench, a redesigned benchmark for evaluating language prior dependency in MLLMs. Existing benchmarks rely on a shared-prior assumption, yet cross-model prior agreement falls below 80%, and accuracy overestimates prior resistance as over 15% of items can be answered without any image, motivating a re-examination of how prior resistance should be measured.
blocks.zh: 我们提出ViSiP-Bench,这是一个重新设计的基准,用于评估MLLMs语言之前的依赖性. 现有基准依赖于共同优先的假设,但跨模式的先前协议低于80%,准确性高估了先前超过15%的阻力,无需任何图像就可以解答,这促使人们重新审视如何衡量先前的阻力。

blocks.en: ViSiP-Bench addresses these issues through a model-aware dynamic prior induction protocol paired with three complementary metrics. PAR and Filtered Accuracy capture prior resistance at the decision level by conditioning on each model’s own elicited prior, while VIG provides a continuous measure of the confidence shift induced by visual evidence. Evaluation of 24 models reveals that prior adherence is pervasive across model families, does not diminish with scale, and manifests as VIG Polarization in larger models, which either override their priors decisively or adhere to them just as firmly. These findings suggest that inference-time interventions alone are insufficient, motivating a training-based solution that avoids indiscriminately suppressing the model’s world knowledge.
blocks.zh: ViSiP-Bench通过一个具有模型意识的动态前起感应协议来解决这些问题,该协议配以三个互补的衡量标准。 PAR 和被过滤的准确性通过对每个模型自己在前所引出的数据进行条件限制,在决策一级捕捉到先前的阻力,而VIG则提供视觉证据所引发的信心转移的连续度量. 对24个模型的评价表明,先前的坚持率在模范家庭很普遍,没有随着规模的缩小而降低,在较大的模型中表现为VIG极化,要么果断地压倒其前科,要么同样坚定地坚持。 这些调查结果表明,光靠推论时间干预是不够的,这促使采取基于培训的解决办法,避免不加区别地压制模型的世界知识。

blocks.en: We therefore propose MAPS, which identifies each model’s most strongly held priors and softens them by enriching the model with targeted, factually grounded knowledge of rare-but-real scenarios, rather than suppressing priors indiscriminately. MAPS achieves substantial improvements in PAR and VIG on ViSiP-Bench while preserving performance on reasoning and general vision benchmarks, and this behavior holds consistently across seven models spanning three architecture families, demonstrating that enhanced visual reliance can be obtained without sacrificing a model’s broader capabilities.
blocks.zh: 因此,我们提出MAPS,它确定每个模型最坚定的先验,并通过对罕见但真实的情景有针对性和基于事实的了解来丰富模型,而不是不加区别地压制先验。 MAPS在ViSiP-Bench上实现了PAR和VIG的重大改进,同时保持了推理和一般视觉基准的性能,这种行为在跨越三个建筑家族的7个模型中持续地存在,表明可以在不牺牲模型更广泛的能力的情况下增强视觉依赖。

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en: First, the six categories in ViSiP-Bench, though designed to broadly cover commonsense knowledge relevant to MLLMs, follow a fixed taxonomy and cannot capture every form of world knowledge a model may rely on. Priors rooted in specialized domains or in rapidly evolving knowledge fall outside this taxonomy, and whether the patterns of prior adherence we observe extend to such cases remains an open question for future benchmarks to address.
blocks.zh: 首先,ViSiP-Bench的六个类别虽然旨在广泛涵盖与MLLMs有关的常识知识,但遵循固定的分类法,无法捕捉模型可能依赖的每一种世界知识。 扎根于专门领域或迅速发展的知识的历史不属于这一分类范围,我们所观察到的先前遵守的模式是否延伸至此类情况,仍然是未来基准有待解决的问题。

blocks.en: Second, VIG relies on token-level output probabilities and is therefore inapplicable to closed models accessed only through APIs. This leaves the VIG Polarization phenomenon reported in this work unverified for proprietary models, which may exhibit different confidence dynamics than what we observe here.
blocks.zh: 第二,VIG依赖于符号级输出概率,因此不适用于仅通过API访问的封闭模型. 这使得本作所报道的VIG极化现象对于专有模型没有经过验证,可能表现出与我们这里所观察到的不同的信心动态.

blocks.en: Ethical Considerations
blocks.zh: 道德考虑

blocks.en: Data construction relies on proprietary generative models, including Claude Opus 4.7 for prior enumeration and scenario generation, and GPT-Image-2 and Nano Banana 2 for image synthesis, all accessed through official APIs in accordance with the respective providers’ usage policies. Evaluation additionally involves querying proprietary models such as GPT-5.5, Claude Sonnet 4.6, and Gemini-3-flash-preview through their official APIs, again in compliance with the applicable terms of service. Content synthesized by generative models, as well as web-sourced images, is subject to the same three-criteria quality review, which additionally serves to filter out any inappropriate or misleading generations before inclusion in ViSiP-Bench. Human annotation involved in question and option design, as well as quality verification, was carried out by voluntary annotators who were fully informed of the task and compensated fairly for their time; the annotation task does not involve exposure to violent, explicit, or otherwise harmful content, as all images depict ordinary, if uncommon, real-world scenarios.
blocks.zh: 数据构建依赖于专有的基因模型,包括Claude Opus 4.7用于先前的查点和情景生成,以及GPT-Image-2和Nano Banana 2用于图像合成,它们都根据各自供应商的使用政策通过官方API访问. 评估还涉及查询专利模型,如GPT-5.5、克洛德·索内特4.6和双子座-3-闪光-审查,这同样符合适用的服务条款。 由基因模型以及网络来源图像所合成的内容,都要接受相同的"三个标准"的质量审查,这又有助于过滤出任何不恰当或误导的世代后再被收录入ViSiP-Bench. 涉及问题和选项设计以及质量核查的人类注释是由自愿的注释者进行的,他们充分了解这项任务并公平补偿他们的时间;注释任务不涉及暴露于暴力、明确或以其他方式有害的内容,所有图像都描绘的是普通的、如果不寻常的、真实的世界情景。

blocks.en: We note that generative AI tools were employed only for editing purposes, such as improving wording and sentence clarity, and played no role in the underlying research. All ideas, experiments, analyses, and conclusions presented in this paper originate from and were validated by the authors.
blocks.zh: 我们注意到,基因AI工具只用于编辑目的,如改进措辞和句子清晰度,在基础研究中没有发挥作用。 本文中提出的所有想法、实验、分析和结论都来源于作者,并得到了作者的证实。

blocks.en: Appendix A Data Quality Analysis
blocks.zh: 附录A 数据质量分析

blocks.en: A.1 Identification of No-Image Correct Responses
blocks.zh: A.1 确定无图像正确反应

blocks.en: Over 15% of items in existing benchmarks can be answered correctly without any image. To identify the source of each such response and categorize it into one of three types ( Chance Success , Low-quality Framing , or Anomalous Prior ), we adopt a hybrid pipeline combining automated screening with human verification.
blocks.zh: 现有基准中超过15%的项目可以在没有任何图像的情况下正确回答。 为了确定每个此类反应的来源并将其分类为三种类型之一(成功的机会、低质量的Framing或异常的Prior),我们采用了一种混合管道,将自动筛选与人类核查结合起来。

blocks.en: The pipeline proceeds as follows. All items answered correctly under the Blank condition are first collected as candidates. Each candidate then undergoes the following three-stage procedure.
blocks.zh: 输油管如下: 在空白条件下正确答复的所有物品首先作为候选人收集。 每个候选人然后经过以下三个阶段的程序。

blocks.en: Table 6: Representative examples of the three sources of no-image correct responses.
blocks.zh: 表6:无图像正确反应三个来源的代表性实例。

blocks.en: Stage 1: Human Verification of Question Quality. Human annotators examine each candidate question along two dimensions. First, they assess whether the question is associated with a sufficiently strong and unambiguous commonsense prior. Questions where the correct answer is genuinely uncertain even without an image (for example, “what color is the dragon fruit?” where both red and white are valid) are flagged as Low-quality Framing due to an insufficiently strong prior. Second, annotators check whether the question wording contains implicit hints that guide the model toward the anomalous answer. For instance, a question such as “what is unusual about the color of the rose in this image?” implicitly signals that the rose’s color is atypical, nudging the model toward selecting an uncommon option such as black or white. Such items are also categorized as Low-quality Framing .
blocks.zh: 第一阶段:对问题质量进行人文核查。 人类的注释者从两个方面审查每个候选人的问题。 首先,它们评估这个问题是否与先前足够强烈和明确的常识有关。 正确答案即使没有图像也确实不确定的问题(例如:"龙果是什么颜色? 红色和白色都有效),由于前作不够强而被标为低质量的花纹. 第二,注释者检查问题措辞是否包含暗示,引导模型向反常的答案走去. 例如,一个诸如“这幅图中的玫瑰的颜色有什么不同寻常的?” 的问题隐含地表明玫瑰的颜色是非典型的,淡化了模型来选择一种不寻常的选择,如黑色或白色。 这类物品还被归类为低质量花纹。

blocks.en:
Stage 2: Automated Probability Analysis. Items that pass Stage 1 (i.e., those with a strong and unambiguous prior and no implicit hints) are further analyzed by re-querying the target model under the Blank condition and extracting the full probability distribution over all answer options via softmax over the output logits. If the variance across option probabilities is low, indicating that the model assigns similar probabilities to all options, the item is categorized as Chance Success . This pattern is particularly prevalent in smaller models with weaker prior knowledge, where correct responses arise from random selection rather than genuine prior activation.
In our implementation, if the maximum probability among all options falls below 65%, the item is categorized as Chance Success .
blocks.zh:
第2阶段:自动化概率分析。 通过第1阶段的项目(即那些有强烈和毫不含糊的前兆且没有隐含暗示的项目),通过在 Blank 条件下重新填充目标模型,并通过对输出日志的软max提取所有答案选项的全部概率分布,进一步分析. 如果跨选项概率的差异较低,表明模型给所有选项分配了类似的概率,则该项目被归类为"概率成功". 这种模式在先前知识较弱的较小模型中尤其普遍,因为随机选择而不是真正的事先激活会产生正确的反应。
如果所有选项的最大概率都低于65%,

blocks.en: Stage 3: Anomalous Prior Identification. If the probability distribution exhibits high variance, with one option receiving substantially higher probability than the others, the model is judged to hold a strong prior for this question. Since the model answers correctly under the Blank condition despite the item being designed to conflict with commonsense expectations, this indicates that the model inherently treats the anomalous answer as its own prior. Such items are categorized as Anomalous Prior .
blocks.zh: 第3阶段:异常先验。 如果概率分布显示出高差异,一个选项得到的概率大大高于其他选项,则该模型被认为在这个问题之前具有很强的概率。 由于该模型在"空白条件"下正确答案,尽管这个项目被设计成与常识期望相冲突,这表明该模型内在地将异常答案视为自己的前作. 这类物品被归类为 " 异常以前 " 。

blocks.en: Appendix C Cross-Model and Cross-Family Validation of MAPS
blocks.zh: 附录C MAPS的跨模式和跨家庭验证

blocks.en: To verify that the effectiveness of MAPS is not specific to a single backbone, we apply MAPS to six additional models spanning three architecture families: InternVL3.5 (2B, 8B), InternVL3 (14B), Qwen2.5-VL (7B), Qwen3.5 (9B), and LLaVA-OneVision (7B). All models are fine-tuned under an identical configuration (prior probing threshold α = 0.90 \alpha=0.90 , LoRA fine-tuning for 2 epochs), with no per-model hyperparameter adjustment, to verify that the improvement generalizes without model-specific tuning.
blocks.zh: 为了证实MAPS的有效性不是针对单一骨干,我们把MAPS应用于涵盖三个建筑家族的另外六个模型:InternVL3.5(2B,8B),InternVL3(14B),Qun2.5-VL(7B),Qun3.5(9B)和LLaVA-One Vision(7B). 所有型号均在相同的配置下进行微调(前作检测阈值α = 0.90\alpha = 0.90,LORA微调为2个历段),不进行每个型号的超参数调整,以验证改进一般化,而无需模型特定的调取.

blocks.en: Table 8: Cross-model results on ViSiP-Bench. MAPS consistently reduces PAR and increases Filtered Accuracy and VIG across all six models spanning three architecture families, while FC remains close to the base model, indicating that prior knowledge is not indiscriminately disrupted.
blocks.zh: 表8:ViSiP-Bench上的跨模型结果. MAPS持续减少PAR并增加跨越三个建筑家族的所有6个模型的过滤精确度和VIG,而FC仍然接近基础模型,表明先前的知识不会被不加区分地破坏.

blocks.en: Table 8 reports results on ViSiP-Bench. Across all six models, MAPS consistently reduces PAR (by 3.44 to 8.06 points) and improves Filtered Accuracy (by 3.62 to 8.15 points), with no exceptions across model scale (2B–14B) or family. FC increases only marginally (by 2 to 7 samples), in sharp contrast to the collapse observed for Post-hoc in Table 3 (147 → \to 385), confirming that MAPS softens rather than indiscriminately erodes prior knowledge. VIG improves substantially for every model, in most cases more than doubling, indicating that the effect is not confined to a single backbone but reflects a general property of the model-aware prior softening procedure. We note that the absolute PAR reduction for LLaVA-OneVision-7B (-4.09) is somewhat smaller than for other models; this model also exhibits the highest base PAR (67.10) among the six, suggesting that models with a very large number of strongly held priors may require a longer fine-tuning schedule or a larger rare-but-real corpus to achieve proportionally similar gains.
blocks.zh: 表8报告ViSiP-Bench的情况。 在所有6个模型中,MAPS一致地将PAR(降低3.44分到8.06分)并改进了滤精度(降低3.62分到8.15分),在模型尺度(2B–14B)或家族之间没有例外. FC只略微增加(从2到7个样本),与表3(147~\至385)中观察到的Host-hoc倒塌形成鲜明对比,证实MAPS软化而非不加区别地侵蚀了先前的知识. VIG对每一种模型都大有改进,在多数情况下都翻了一番以上,表明效果并不局限于一个主干,而是反映了模型意识先起软化程序的一般属性. 我们注意到,LLaVA-One Vision-7B(4.09)的绝对PAR削减比其他模型略小;这一模型还显示六种模型中最高的PAR(67.10),这表明拥有大量强前科的模型可能需要更长的微调时间表或更大的稀有但实际的体积,以取得比例相近的收益。

blocks.en: Table 9: Generalization results on reasoning (MMMU-Pro, VisuLogic) and general vision (MMStar, RealWorldQA) benchmarks across six models. MAPS preserves performance within a narrow margin for every model, with no consistent direction of degradation.
blocks.zh: 表9:一般化对六个模型的推理(MMMU-Pro、VisuLogic)和一般视觉(MMStar、RealWorldQA)基准的结果。 MAPS将每个模型的性能保存在狭长的距离内,没有一致的降解方向.

blocks.en: Table 9 reports generalization results on the same six models. The largest absolute change across all 24 model–benchmark pairs is 0.87 points (MMStar, InternVL3.5-2B), and changes are not consistently signed: some models show small gains on certain benchmarks and small losses on others, with no systematic degradation pattern. This indicates that the preservation of general reasoning and visual understanding capabilities observed for Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct in Table 4 is not an artifact of that particular model, but a consistent property of MAPS across scales and architecture families.
blocks.zh: 表9报告了上述六个模式的概况。 所有24个模型-基准对的最大绝对变化为0.87分(MMStar, InternVL3.5-2B),变化并非一致地被签名:一些模型显示在某些基准上得分很小,而另一些模型则出现小损失,没有系统的降解模式. 这表明,在表4中为Qune3-VL-8B-Instruction所观察到的一般推理和视觉理解能力,不是该特定模型的一件艺术品,而是MAPS在尺度和建筑家族之间一致的财产.

blocks.en: Appendix D Annotation Guidelines
blocks.zh: 附录D 说明准则

blocks.en: Task Description. You will be presented with an image depicting a rare-but-real scenario that conflicts with commonsense expectations. Your task is to design a multiple-choice question that requires the respondent to carefully observe the image in order to answer correctly. The correct answer must be visually grounded in the image, and must differ clearly from what one would expect based on commonsense knowledge alone.
blocks.zh: 任务描述. 将呈现一个形象,描绘一种与常识期望相冲突的罕见但真实的情景. 你的任务是设计一个多选题,要求被申请人仔细观察图像,以便正确回答. 正确的答案必须直观地以图像为基础,必须明确不同于人们仅仅根据常识所期望的。

blocks.en: What is a Commonsense Prior? A commonsense prior is a default expectation about the world that a person (or model) holds based on general knowledge. For example, most people expect swans to be white. If an image shows a black swan, a respondent relying on their prior rather than the image would incorrectly answer “white”. Questions should be designed so that relying on the prior leads to a wrong answer, while carefully observing the image leads to the correct one.
blocks.zh: 什么是常识前传? 常识先行指一个人(或模型)基于一般知识对世界的默认期望. 例如,大多数人认为天鹅是白色的. 如果一个图像显示一只黑天鹅,一个依赖其先前而不是图像的被申请人就会错误地回答“白色”。 问题的设计应使依赖前作的线索导致错误的答案,同时仔细地观察图像导致正确的答案.

blocks.en: Question Design Requirements.
blocks.zh: 问题设计要求.

blocks.en: (1) Identify the anomalous element in the image and formulate a question that directly targets it.
blocks.zh: (1) 识别图像中的异常因素并拟订直接针对它的问题。

blocks.en: (2) Phrase the question in a neutral and objective manner. Do not use any wording that hints at the anomalous nature of the image (e.g., avoid phrases such as “what is unusual about…”).
blocks.zh: (2) 以中立和客观的方式表述问题。 不要使用任何暗示图像异常性质的措辞(例如,避免“什么是不寻常的......”等短语)。

blocks.en: (3) Provide exactly four answer choices. One choice must correspond to the visually correct answer; the remaining three must be plausible distractors grounded in commonsense expectations.
blocks.zh: (3) 提供准确的四种答案选择。 一种选择必须与视觉上正确的答案相对应;其余三种选择必须是基于常识期望的可信的分心者。

blocks.en: (4) Ensure that no option is obviously implausible, as this would allow the correct answer to be identified by elimination.
blocks.zh: (4) 确保任何选择都显然不可信,因为这样就可以通过删除确定正确的答案。

blocks.en: Table 10: Per-category PAR results for all evaluated models. Scientific & Mathematic consistently exhibits the highest PAR values, while Physical Properties proves most amenable to visual override.
blocks.zh: 表10:所有评价模型的每个类别PAR结果。 科学和数学一贯显示最高的PAR值,而物理属性证明最容易被视觉覆盖。

blocks.en: Quality Review Criteria. Each sample must satisfy all three of the following criteria:
blocks.zh: 质量审查标准。 每个样本必须符合以下所有三项标准:

blocks.en: (1) The image is visually clear and unambiguously supports a single correct answer.
blocks.zh: (1) 图像在视觉上清楚无误地支持一个正确的答案。

blocks.en: (2) All answer choices are directly relevant to the question and cannot be eliminated by common sense alone.
blocks.zh: (2)所有答案选择都与问题直接相关,不能仅由常识来消除.

blocks.en: (3) The question wording contains no hint of anomaly that would suppress prior activation before the respondent views the image.
blocks.zh: (3) 问题措辞没有暗示异常之处,在被申请人看到图像之前会抑制事先激活。

blocks.en: Common Mistakes. Please avoid the following common errors:
blocks.zh: 常见出错. 请避免以下常见错误:

blocks.en: (1) Implicit anomaly hints : Phrasing such as “what is unusual about the color of the rose?” signals that something is atypical, guiding the respondent toward the anomalous answer without looking at the image.
blocks.zh: (1) 隐性异常提示: “玫瑰的颜色有什么不同寻常之处?” 这样的描述表明,有些东西是非典型的,引导被申请人在不看图像的情况下向反常的答案走去。

blocks.en: (2) Eliminable distractors : Including options that are obviously implausible allows the correct answer to be identified by elimination rather than visual observation.
blocks.zh: (2) 易感分心器: 包括明显不可信的选项,可以通过去除而不是视觉观察来识别正确的答案.

blocks.en: (3) Ambiguous reference : Questions such as “what color is this?” without specifying the target object introduce ambiguity. Always specify the object clearly (e.g., “what color is the watermelon flesh?”).
blocks.zh: (3) 含糊不清的参考资料: 诸如“这是什么颜色?” 这样的问题,如果不具体说明目标对象,就会产生模糊性。 总是清晰地指定对象(例如“西瓜肉是什么颜色?” )。

blocks.en: Disagreement Resolution. If the two reviewers disagree on whether a sample passes review, the case is escalated to a third arbitrator whose decision is final. All samples must reach unanimous agreement before inclusion in the dataset.
blocks.zh: 分歧解决. 如果两名审查人员对样本是否通过审查有分歧,案件将升级为第三名仲裁员,其裁决为最终裁决。 所有样本在纳入数据集之前必须达成一致意见.

blocks.en: Appendix E Per-Category Analysis
blocks.zh: 附录E 按类别 分析

blocks.en: Table 10 presents the per-category PAR results for all evaluated models. Scientific & Mathematic consistently exhibits the highest PAR values across model families, while Physical Properties proves most amenable to visual override. This pattern remains largely consistent across models, suggesting that category-level difficulty is an intrinsic property of the prior type rather than a model-specific characteristic.
blocks.zh: 表10列出所有评价模型的每个类别PAR结果。 科学和数学在模范家庭中始终表现出最高的PAR值,而物理属性最容易被视觉覆盖。 这种模式在各模型之间大体一致,表明类别层次的困难是前一种类型的内在属性,而不是模型特有的特征.

blocks.en: Appendix F Prompt Template
blocks.zh: 附录F 提示模板

blocks.en: To ensure a fair comparison between the Blank and Visual conditions, we use an identical prompt template for both. The prompt is designed for image-based questions, with the instruction to guess based on prior knowledge when no image is visible. This design ensures that any difference in model responses between the two conditions is attributable solely to the presence or absence of the image, rather than any difference in the prompt.
blocks.zh: 为了确保Blank和Visual条件之间的公平比较,我们对两者使用相同的即时模板。 提示是针对基于图像的问题设计的,当没有图像可见时,指令可以根据先前的知识来猜测. 这种设计确保两种条件在模型反应上的任何区别完全归因于图像的存在或缺失,而不是即时的区别.

blocks.en: The prompt template used in both conditions is as follows:
blocks.zh: 这两个条件使用的即时模板如下:

blocks.en: In this picture, [QUESTION] A. [OPTION A] B. [OPTION B] C. [OPTION C] D. [OPTION D] If you cannot see the image, please make your best guess among all answer choices based on your own judgment.
blocks.zh: 在此图片中,[问 . A. [方案A] B. [方案B] C. [方案C] D. [方案D] 如果无法看到图像,请根据自己的判断,在所有答案选择中作出最佳的猜测。
